GL-11.statement: A fresh source-neutral POC reaches the exact frozen A5 agreement through the existing A2-A5 spine, then ExitSpec selects the executable evidence method from the frozen per-criterion binding and runs the generic orchestration service with acknowledgement and idempotency only.

GL-12.statement: Evidence admission, independent recalculation, typed criterion verdicts, and MUST_HAVE reduction are separate from producer claims; rejected ingestion has no acceptance reduction, while admitted unsupported or insufficient evidence is explicitly NOT_PROVEN.

GL-13.statement: The append-only attempt history has one current pointer: reserving a successor displaces an earlier current attempt before work, terminal predecessor semantics remain intact, cancellation is terminal, and a late completion is historical and cannot replace the successor.

GL-14.statement: An immutable contract/run-bound Evidence Pack is published only for admitted current terminal evidence, is verified with bounded exact artifacts, and the public packet route rejects tampering and non-packet paths.

GL-15.statement: The current eligible Evidence Pack supports a human handoff or explicit stop with visible status, limitations, next action, historical/current state, and shipping_authorized=false; closure never authorizes deployment, spending, procurement, production traffic, shipping, or other external action.

fresh_browser_a2_to_a6_pass_pack_handoff.requirement: Fresh generated POC: A2 source, A3 retained proposals, mixed A4 plan, exact A5 customer confirmation/freeze, A6 PASS, immutable pack, and current human handoff.

service_successor_displacement_cancel_st.requirement: Service-level successor reservation displaces current state before work; cancellation and late stale completion preserve terminal/history semantics.

admitted_not_proven_vs_catalog_ingestion.requirement: An unsupported MUST_HAVE reaches COMPLETED with NOT_PROVEN and a reduction; an unknown server-catalog reference reaches INGESTION_REJECTED with reduction null and no pack.

http_tamper_rejection.requirement: The exact public decision-packet route verifies the pack, captures bounded bytes, and rejects a same-size tamper before serving.

api_authority_injection.requirement: The evidence start API accepts acknowledgement/idempotency and an opaque catalog reference only; caller method or authority fields are rejected.

release_gate.required_proof: Every acceptance_matrix entry above is exercised by the named focused service, API, HTTP, or Chromium test.

allowed_skip.name: optional external A10 exact pinned archive acceptance
allowed_skip.meaning: The archive is intentionally external and not vendored; no local accepted managed import is claimed when it is unavailable.

limitations: Storage and closure are process-local, in-memory, non-durable, and not shared across workers.
This PR includes only the authorized A5 snapshot-concurrency and recursive authority-key test hardening; frozen A1-A5 identifiers and artifacts remain unchanged.
EXECUTABLE uses the server-owned deterministic support-agent fixture and the synthetic demo profile; it is not real endpoint proof and has no provider call.
Accepted managed import is optionally proven only when the exact external A10 archive is supplied through EXITSPEC_INFERDROME_A10_ARCHIVE; the intentional focused skip is disclosed above.
The release proof does not authorize deployment, spending, procurement, production traffic, shipping, or Train B/A7 work.
